A1.justification: Both complete, readable PDFs describe the same DiME research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original Gaussian-mixture simulations, MNIST phase-retrieval evaluations, and real and synthetic black-hole imaging experiments in Section 4 and Appendices E–F.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including quantitative evidence estimates, baseline comparisons, model selection, and prior-validation experiments.

M1.justification: DiME's covariance approximation, paired-sample likelihood-score estimation, and Algorithms 1–2 are unchanged. The alternative estimators in Appendix B are also retained.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Gaussian-mixture scenarios, MNIST Gaussian/Fourier phase-retrieval tasks, real M87* observations, and synthetic measurements from five prior families. The added calibrated-data citation does not introduce different evaluation data.

E2.justification: The Gaussian-mixture comparisons retain Naive MC, the original DAPS covariance heuristic, TI, AIS, and SMC; SMC remains the MNIST comparator. Coeurdoux et al. is newly cited but not evaluated.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D retain the same experimental settings, including 100 discretization steps for Gaussian-mixture tests, 50 annealing steps for learned-prior evaluations, and 20 sample paths. Preprocessing, noise levels, and Langevin settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: The covariance-heuristic comparison in Section 4.1, SMC schedule/noise sensitivity analyses in Appendix E, and GRMHD out-of-distribution checks in Section 4.3.2 retain the same questions and evidence.

E5.justification: Both retain mean and standard deviation over 50 trials in Table 1 and five runs in Tables 2–3. Sample-path distributions and the Gaussian-fit, z-score, and p-value reporting for M87* are also unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3, Figures 2–11, and the reported empirical findings retain the same results. For example, Table 1's in-distribution DiME estimate remains -126.8 ± 2.8, and the M87* evidence remains 231.46 with z-score -0.81.

T1.justification: Proposition 1 replaces an explicit likelihood integral with the equivalent p(y|x_t), already defined in Section 2.2, and simplifies coefficient typography. Mathematical assumptions, estimators, and proofs in Appendices A–B are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution paragraph, and conclusion retain the same claims about sample-efficient evidence estimation, prior selection, prior-misfit diagnosis, and applicability to black-hole imaging.

C2.justification: Figure 4 and Section 4.3.1 remove the identification of individual samples' path evidence with negatively proportional KL divergence to the prior. This narrows the interpretation of those sample-level quantities; the distribution-level KL formulation and other interpretations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The reproducibility statement changes a promised future code/model release into reported availability at a specific DiME repository address. Appendix D's technical details are unchanged, and both versions state that RIAF and GRMHD datasets are not publicly available. The PDFs alone do not verify repository contents.

R1.justification: v2 adds Coeurdoux et al. (2024) to the diffusion-sampling background and PnP-DM lineage, plus an EHTC calibrated-data reference. Journal metadata updates and changed citation suffixes for existing EHT papers do not constitute additional works.

P1.justification: v2 removes the accidental author-template footnote and makes localized wording, paragraph-break, and proposition-presentation edits. Section order and the overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 4's caption is shortened, and text/reference edits cause limited page reflow. No figures or tables are added, removed, or redrawn; plots, image panels, table structures, axes, and legends remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves access documentation through a concrete code/model repository address, adds relevant attribution, removes misleading sample-level KL wording, and deletes an editorial placeholder. These are useful refinements, while the methods, proofs, and empirical evidence remain unchanged and the stated training-data access limitations persist.
